notes: Access: direct HTTP with curl_cffi impersonation (chrome124/safari17_0) reached the homepage (200) and yielded the full site-wide mega-menu JSON (window state embedded in SSR HTML), confirming one dedicated Pet Care universe 'Animaux de compagnie' with 4 real child categories (Boites a croquettes, Gamelles, Paniers/jouets/tapis pour animaux, Arbre a chat) plus an additionalChild 'Voir tous les accessoires pour les animaux' pointing back to the parent URL (navigation/view-all link, not a distinct category). All /c/ category-listing pages (parent and all 4 children) returned DataDome's JS-challenge/CAPTCHA block (403 or, via headless Playwright, a geo.captcha-delivery.com CAPTCHA iframe) under both direct HTTP and Playwright/CDP -- consistent with the prior Home-Decor pass's finding for this host. robots.txt (fetched successfully, 200) lists ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Anthropic-ai in a group with scoped Disallow rules (account/order/search/query-param/login paths) -- no full-site 'Disallow: /' for Claude -- so escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) per the brief, which reached all 5 real pages successfully (real browser session bypassed the CAPTCHA) and read each page's own 'N articles' result-count header. The parent 'Animalerie' page itself shows 98 articles (with a 'Marque Maisons du Monde' filter chip present but NOT active on any of the 5 pages, so that is not the source of the discrepancy) -- lower than every child's own count (18/38/289/319), which is a real site catalog quirk (parent likely counts only directly-tagged items, not the recursive union of children, and/or marketplace-seller items appear only under child nodes). Per the grouping rule this is moot: the parent is recorded as a grouping row (is_group true, qty null, link null) and its own number is not used, so there is no double-count risk regardless of the discrepancy. Checked the full site mega-menu dump (homepage embedded nav JSON, all universes/categories) for any other pet-related branch outside 'Animaux de compagnie' -- found none; this is the sole Pet Care section on the site. No pet food/treat consumable category found (Boites a croquettes is kibble/food STORAGE boxes, not food itself, matching the brief's explicit Tier-1 'Pet Food/Treat Storage' -- not flagged as a consumable). No medical/veterinary category found. All 4 leaf categories confirmed via product listing content as genuinely pet-specific (first product on each PLP is a dog/cat item).
